land|Memorial to Folly|Swamp.why: Memorial returns Gray Merchant or Mindslicer from the graveyard to hand, an ability the land score can't see; the deck still has 31 Swamps.

spell|Mutilate|Mind Stone.why: Every Mind Stone is in another deck, so this would share a copy; Mutilate is one of two wipes. A free Commander's Sphere fills the ramp gap instead (A/B +0.6% engine online, ±0.5).
